direction.text: It audits the screen and proposes a direction before it edits anything, so you can steer it early. If the screen is already good, it tells you so and suggests a few small refinements instead of redesigning it.

passes.text: Passes. Spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals and motion, in that order.

paid.text: Visuals. Shows your product instead of a glossy blob. When a hero needs a scene or an object, it can generate one through an image service like fal, Replicate, OpenAI images or Higgsfield.
